verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a hosted tax API/service where rate calculation happens server-side per request (kintsugi-docs-9, kintsugi-docs-31, kintsugi-docs-25), so by architecture customers never redeploy code to get new rates — the API just returns current rates reflecting nexus, taxability, exemptions and address. But there is no explicit documentation of a changelog, release notes, or 'effective date' disclosure process for rate/rule changes across jurisdictions. Missing for 10: documented changelog or notification process for rate/rule updates, explicit statement of update cadence/effective dates, and independent confirmation that rates stay current without any customer-side action.
